description: This file defines the Order model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, providing methods to retrieve order details, products, histories, and related data from the database.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Model class for handling order data, including retrieval of order details, products, options, histories, and totals.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order by its ID, including country and zone codes for payment and shipping addresses.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves a list of orders for the current customer with pagination support.

methods.name: getOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Retrieves orders associated with a specific subscription ID.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a specific order product.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Retrieves total amounts related to an order.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the number of history records for an order.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts total orders for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByProductId
methods.description: Counts total orders containing a specific product.

methods.name: getTotalProductsByOrderId
methods.description: Counts total products in a specific order.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Counts total orders associated with a specific subscription.
